//AllowedHosts: Left open on purpose: the framework's filter cannot exempt the health probes. HostAllowlist (appsettings.Production.json, HostAllowlist.cs) is the restriction.

ClientAddress.//: How many proxies in front of the app append to X-Forwarded-For; see ClientAddress.cs. 1 suits a single ingress and local runs. Production is Cloudflare then the Container Apps ingress, which appsettings.Production.json sets to 2. Override with the ClientAddress__ForwardedHops environment variable.
